name: Hulu Imagine Dragons: Live from Vegas Experience
desc:
Update: The Watch Party is over, but you can still make it rain lightning -- and more -- in the theater!

Experience the Imagine Dragons: Live from Las Vegas on Roblox! Celebrate the release of the Imagine Dragons’ Hulu Documentary with this limited-time event! 

🎫COLLECT VIP Badges to earn an exclusive UGC item 
🔒UNLOCK the band’s Green Room
🛍️SHOP Imagine Dragons’ UGC merch
👊DESTROY statues from Imagine Dragons’ music videos

🎸Join the party and rock out with Imagine Dragons on Roblox till August 3rd!
